```{python}
import json
import geopandas as gpd
import pdal
from shapely.geometry import box, Point

orting = gpd.GeoSeries([Point(-122.2043, 47.0979)], crs=4326).to_crs(2856).iloc[0]
x0 = orting.x // 1000 * 1000
y0 = orting.y // 1000 * 1000
test_cell = box(x0, y0, x0 + 1000, y0 + 1000)
test_cell_ept = gpd.GeoSeries([test_cell], crs=2856).to_crs(3857).iloc[0]
print(test_cell.bounds)
```
```{python}
ept = "https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/WA_PierceCounty_1_2020/ept.json"
os.makedirs("data/raw/lidar2020_test", exist_ok=True)

pipeline = [
    {"type": "readers.ept", "filename": ept, "polygon": test_cell_ept.wkt, "resolution": 0.5},
    {"type": "filters.range", "limits": "Classification[2:2],Classification[9:9]"},
    {"type": "filters.reprojection", "in_srs": "EPSG:3857", "out_srs": "EPSG:2856"},
    {"type": "writers.las", "filename": "data/raw/lidar2020_test/orting_test.laz",
     "a_srs": "EPSG:2856+5703", "minor_version": 4, "dataformat_id": 6},
]

p = pdal.Pipeline(json.dumps(pipeline))
n = p.execute()
print(f"{n:,} points written")
```
```{python}
import numpy as np

corridor = gpd.read_file("data/reach/corridor.geojson").to_crs(2856)
shape = corridor.geometry.iloc[0]
xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = shape.bounds

cells = []
for x in np.arange(xmin // 1000 * 1000, xmax, 1000):
    for y in np.arange(ymin // 1000 * 1000, ymax, 1000):
        piece = box(x, y, x + 1000, y + 1000).intersection(shape)
        if not piece.is_empty:
            cells.append({"name": f"cell_{int(x)}_{int(y)}", "geometry": piece})

cells = gpd.GeoDataFrame(cells, crs=2856)
print(len(cells), "cells")

ax = corridor.plot(color="lightsteelblue", figsize=(5, 7))
cells.boundary.plot(ax=ax, color="k", linewidth=0.5)
```
```{python}
import time
from pathlib import Path

out_dir = Path("data/raw/lidar2020")
partial = out_dir / "_partial"
partial.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def download_cell(name, geom):
    out_file = out_dir / f"{name}.laz"
    if out_file.exists():
        return "already done"

    tmp = partial / f"{name}.laz"
    geom_ept = gpd.GeoSeries([geom], crs=2856).to_crs(3857).iloc[0]
    pipeline = [
        {"type": "readers.ept", "filename": ept, "polygon": geom_ept.wkt, "resolution": 0.5},
        {"type": "filters.range", "limits": "Classification[2:2],Classification[9:9]"},
        {"type": "filters.reprojection", "in_srs": "EPSG:3857", "out_srs": "EPSG:2856"},
        {"type": "writers.las", "filename": str(tmp),
         "a_srs": "EPSG:2856+5703", "minor_version": 4, "dataformat_id": 6},
    ]
    n = pdal.Pipeline(json.dumps(pipeline)).execute()

    if n == 0:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return "no ground points"
    tmp.replace(out_file)
    return f"{n:,} points"

start = time.time()
for i, row in enumerate(cells.itertuples(), start=1):
    result = download_cell(row.name, row.geometry)
    minutes = (time.time() - start) / 60
    print(f"[{i}/{len(cells)}] {row.name}: {result}  ({minutes:.1f} min)")
```
